# Amir Beck

> Senior design engineer and product designer in San Francisco who both designs and ships fintech products. At Lumanu he leads the design of a B2B2C payments platform and personally builds it in React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

## Lumanu

URL: https://amirbeck.com/lumanu
Years: 2023 to now
Role: Lead Design Engineer
Category: Payments Platform

Lumanu is a fintech that processes payments and handles tax compliance for brands paying creators. Amir Beck redesigned the app from the ground up and personally coded 90% of it. The redesign supported a company pivot from influencer marketing to payments, and launched features that created new revenue streams.

Work on the case study includes:

- A role-aware buyer dashboard, designed, built, and animated in React
- An app redesign held to a pixel-perfect bar, with help on the left nav and universal search
- A reporting feature, designed and shipped so clients can audit their finances, using Figma Code Connect and the Figma MCP
- Aligning the design system and the codebase (naming, components, Code Connect) so UI matches development and AI IDEs pick the right components
- A tax engine for global compliance, researched with clients
- Projects, for real-time spending visibility across agencies, SMBs, enterprise, and DTC
- Vendor onboarding and compliance, redesigned using Heap funnel analytics and support data

## SkySlope

URL: https://amirbeck.com/skyslope
Years: 2020 to 2022
Role: UI and UX Designer
Category: Real Estate Platform

SkySlope builds real estate transaction software. Amir Beck improved UX across DigiSign, Forms, and Breeze, and led Breeze from concept through launch.

Outcomes cited on the site:

- Cut digital signing mistakes by ~50%
- 15% increase in cross product usage
- Expanded the product for entire real estate teams, not only individual agents

DigiSign testing found a 40 to 50% error rate placing and assigning signatures. The shipped work included a clearer placement flow and a preferences page for selection behavior. Forms was reshaped so transaction coordinators and agents could share paperwork. Breeze launched as a standalone product.

## Granate

URL: https://amirbeck.com/granate
Years: 2022 to 2023
Role: Lead Product Designer
Category: Grief Support App

Amir Beck led product design for Granate, an app for people going through loss and end of life planning. Work spanned UX, brand, product strategy, marketing, and research.

Outcomes cited on the site:

- ~25% drop in onboarding drop off
- ~30% lift in weekly engagement
- A component system that set the development team up for faster feature delivery

## EasyPeady

URL: https://amirbeck.com/easypeady
Years: 2021
Role: Lead Product Designer
Category: Real Estate Form Streamlining

In late 2020, COVID added the PEAD form to every home viewing. Amir Beck led design and launch of EasyPeady, a web app that auto-fills, sends, and splits PEAD forms. It shipped in one quarter and later became the groundwork for SkySlope Breeze.

Outcomes cited on the site:

- Developed and launched in one quarter
- Generated a pipeline of new paying users

The 15% cross-product usage increase is a SkySlope platform outcome, listed on https://amirbeck.com/skyslope, not a second EasyPeady metric.
